newsitem.title: UK: J.P. Morgan to open office in Johannesburg.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan to open office in Johannesburg.

text.p: U.S. investment bank J.P. Morgan & Co Inc said on Tuesday that it would open an office in Johannesburg, South Africa, early next year.
"The local office will strengthen the firm's commitment to and involvement in South Africa," Walter Gubert, head of the bank's Europe, Africa and the Middle East operations, said in a statement.

The new office, headed by Ronald Gault -- currently a managing director in J.P. Morgan's Municipal Finance group, would enhance the bank's ability to provide financial advisory services to South African clients.

It would also establish, subject to regulatory approvals, a securities trading operation in the country that would give clients access to both the domestic and world markets in commodities, bonds and related financial products, the bank added.
